title.narrative: Supporting transnational peace’ dynamics for cross-border peoples living in Cyangugu and neighbourin

description.narrative: The project aims to fight against the feeling of fear, prejudice and stereotypes leading to the non-confidence of each other. These negative attitudes are noticed among the great lakes sub region’ people, particularly among populations of neighbouring dioceses of Cyangugu (Rwanda), Bubanza (Burundi), Uvira and Bukavu in DRC. Previous CDJP Cyangugu’ project has opened the doors to peoples’ dialogue, but this initiative deserves to be spread and sustain its gains. Based on these internal and external experiences and making use of synergies with other stakeholders in the field of peace, this project plans to enhance the church’ leader’s involvement so that peacebuilding is set as pastoral priorities to mobilize the border communities for fraternal communion for peace. Project seeks to undertake initiatives and opportunities for individual and collective reconciliation, to build mutual trust for people from great lakes region that will solidified relationship among them and bring enabling peace. This project plans to involve people and leaders of border parishes from the four targeted dioceses (Cyangugu, Bubanza, Bukavu and Uvira) in cross-border reconciliation initiatives for peace and reconciliation, in exchanging in peace threats in a comprehensive and tolerant mind and opting for a mutual understanding. This project plan also to develop permanent peace’ clubs managed by youths in all the four targeted dioceses. These peace ‘clubs will educate for peace, fuel a peaceful coexistence, build youths ‘connection and remain the space for transforming negative prejudices and stereotypes for youths. The project’ activities will be executed in the border area of the dioceses of Cyangugu / Rwanda, Bukavu and Uvira (DRC) and Bubanza (Burundi).
